newsitem.title: SPAIN: Sol Melia to invest $61 mln in Caracas hotel.
newsitem.headline: Sol Melia to invest $61 mln in Caracas hotel.

text.p: Spanish hotel group Sol Melia said on Wednesday it would invest $61 million in a hotel complex in Caracas, Venezuela.
Sol Melia said it will invest an initial sum of $40 million, partly financed by the firm's majority shareholders, to buy the rest of the complex where its Melia Caracas hotel is situated.
A further $21 million will fund work necessary to adapt installations and services to Sol Melia's standards.
The total value of the deal is 9.4 billion pesetas, the firm said.
The complex, due to be opened next May, has both hotels and residential property, as well as a shopping centre. The purchase was agreed with Banco Industrial de Venezuela.
Sol Melia said the total $61 million outlay would be 80 percent financed by its main shareholders, while the remaining 20 percent would come from the firm's own funds.
